stayType: Golf resort with self-catering apartments and cottages
accommodation: Two-bedroom apartments and larger family cottages (six and seven bedrooms per Visit Cornwall); total number not stated. Now marketed as The Point Holidays, which also lets homes elsewhere around Polzeath.
suitableFor: Families, groups and golfers; some dog-friendly homes
parking: Parking and disabled parking listed (Visit Cornwall)
dogs: Some dog-friendly properties; pet-free properties also offered
beachAccess: A short walk or quick drive to Polzeath, Daymer Bay and Rock (Visit Cornwall); no distance given
confirmedFeatures: 18-hole golf course, driving range, indoor heated pool, gym, sauna, steam room, padel, tennis, table tennis, restaurant and bar (The Bear), Wi-Fi, EV charging
overview: The Point at Polzeath is a golf resort at St Minver with self-catering apartments and family cottages, now run as The Point Holidays. Guests have use of a health club with indoor pool, plus golf, padel and tennis, and an on-site restaurant and bar. Polzeath and Daymer Bay are a short drive or walk away.
surfTripFit: Works for families mixing surf days at Polzeath with other activities, though it is not on the beach and no surf facilities are stated.
gaps: Exact beach distance, unit numbers and board storage not stated.
